A large-area input pair keeps 1/f noise low."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L
    "Itail": (30e-6, 15e-6, 50e-6),  # first-stage tail current
    "I2":    (60e-6, 30e-6, 90e-6),  # output stage current
    "gmidn": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # NMOS current sinks gm/Id
    "gmidp": (12.0, 8.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror / CS gm/Id
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror + CS L (equal -> no systematic offset)
    "Cc":    (6e-12, 2e-12, 10e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.6, 1.0, 3.0),        # Rz = rzk / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Ln = 2.0
    It, I2, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I2"], p["Cc"]

    m0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], Ln, iref, vds=0.6)          # ibias diode
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], Ln, It, vds=0.25)           # tail
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], Ln, I2, vds=0.9)            # output sink
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5)   # input pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=0.75)  # PMOS mirror
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.75)      # CS output (same density as m3)

    Rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # diode side on vinn device, first-stage output x on vinp device -> non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d", "d", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    cout = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * Cc + c1 * cout + Cc * cout))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2))
    zinv = Cc * (Rz - 1 / m6.gm)   # >0 -> LHP zero
    if zinv > 0:
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw * 2 * PI * zinv))
    pm = min(pm, 89)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I2 / (cl + Cc))
    vdd = 1.8
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat
    cmrr = db(2 * m1.gm / m5.gds * a1 / max(a1, 1)) if m5.gds > 0 else 100
    psrr = gain_db - 6
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 5 * tau
    gamma = 0.8
    vn_th = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * gamma / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    noise = vn_th * 4
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr,
               "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise}
